arguments.code:
# Fetch recommendations (already logged in via spotify_token)
all_recs=[]
page_index=0
page_limit=20
while True:
    page=apis.spotify.show_recommendations(access_token=spotify_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page', page_index, 'count', len(page))
    if not page:
        break
    all_recs.extend(page)
    page_index+=1
print('total_recs', len(all_recs))

# Determine artist least recommended: use the worst (largest index) appearance among recommendations
artist_last_index={}  # artist name -> largest index encountered
artist_last_song={}   # artist name -> song title at that worst index
for idx, rec in enumerate(all_recs):
    artists = rec.get('artists', []) or []
    for a in artists:
        name = a.get('name')
        if name is None:
            continue
        if name not in artist_last_index or idx >= artist_last_index[name]:
            artist_last_index[name]=idx
            artist_last_song[name]=rec.get('title')

print('unique_artists', len(artist_last_index))
# Find maximum last index
max_idx = max(artist_last_index.values())
candidates=[name for name, i in artist_last_index.items() if i==max_idx]
print('max_idx', max_idx)
print('candidates', candidates)
# Deterministic tiebreak: pick alphabetically if multiple
least_artist = sorted(candidates)[0]
print('least_artist', least_artist)
print('least_artist_last_song', artist_last_song[least_artist])
